park_city_imagery_followup.priority: review before any further geographic acquisition
park_city_imagery_followup.reason: 2018 provides four September tiles across the Park City AOI (September 9 and 27); 2021 combines two September 24 tiles with two November 21 tiles and the sample shows widespread snow-like cover. 2016 August coverage is a fallback.
caveats: STAC items are reconstructed from the retained AOI bbox and latest-year fetcher rule; source IDs were not embedded in the existing raster.
Acquisition date does not prove snow-free, cloud-free, or low-shadow pixels.
Check trail construction, closure, reroute and label date before using older imagery as evidence.
park_city_imagery_followup.next_review: Open same-corridor low-resolution previews and inspect affected trail corridors; record snow/shadow/cloud/leaf status, independent trail references, positional uncertainty and permission.
